caption: The corner of a white paper towel is dipped into a cup of blue dye, and the blue creeps up the towel.

sa.check: A cup of blue dye is present.
The corner of a white paper towel is dipped into it.
The blue creeps up the towel.
The colour stops advancing when the towel is lifted out.

pc.expect: The colour climbs from the wet corner upward and stops advancing when the towel is lifted out; it does not retreat.
pc.fail: It spreads from the dry end; or retreats; or keeps climbing fast after the towel is out.

pc.expect: The wet part is the dye's blue and the dry part stays white.
pc.fail: The wet part is a different colour; or the dry part changes; or the whole towel turns blue at once.

pc.expect: The towel is absorbent paper that darkens where wet.
pc.fail: The dye beads off it; or the towel dissolves; or it stays dry in the cup.

pc.expect: The towel moves only with the hand.
pc.fail: It dips itself; or floats; or jumps.
The towel duplicates; or the cup vanishes; or dye appears from nowhere.

pc.expect: The cup and the table stay the same.
pc.fail: The cup changes colour; or the table changes; or the dye changes colour.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
